description:
Problem: since the keyed-dispute change, the reply skeleton renders each prior defect's concedes as the string placeholder "<concedes>" (render.py response_template, verdict.RESPONSE_PLACEHOLDERS) and the templates say to replace every placeholder with a real value, so reviewers write a string; verdict._prior accepts only a JSON boolean or null (verdict.py:372-373). Every attempt on a PR with earlier oracle findings is absent (invalid: prior defect concedes must be a boolean), so the verdict stays pending (live: #3453 run 40499653679, #3548). Tests built replies with Python booleans and never validated a filled rendered skeleton.

Outcome: the skeleton shows concedes as JSON null; the templates say concedes is true or false for a disputed defect and null otherwise; disputed findings still need a real boolean (protocol.py contradiction check, fail closed). A regression test renders the real skeleton for every template, fills it as a model does, and validates it.

Decision gates:
1. Owner 2026-10-27: 'fix this with priority'. The 2026-10-27 merge freeze still applies unless the owner exempts this PR; ask before make pr-arm if the edited-review fix has not merged.
2. Do not coerce strings like "false" into booleans (that would loosen ingress); if the template-only fix cannot pass the live check, stop and ask.
